notes.title: Performence and bug fixing Update
notes.notes:
Hello there Introverts! 

Today we are coming to you with patch notes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/e348f9c6dd00eae1ceeae7fdc9e86f3d72d4d8e8.png

Here are the bugfixes for the patch:

Performance improvement

 SFX performance improvements.
 Character animation performance improvements.
 Environment animation performance improvements.


Visuals

 Character outlines adjusted, so they look better.
 The dragon hoodie no longer renders its tail in front of everything in the cutscenes.
 Some clothes didn't fade in the cutscenes, this is now fixed.
 Boss fights intro now always shows character portraits.
 Introvert no longer flickers in the main menu scene.
 Fixed the moving walls that were looking weird.

  
Awful bugs bugfixes

 The cutscene on level April 7 (level 32) no longer stops the player from moving on.
 The clothes filter no longer breaks when selecting a piece when filtered.


Thank you for your time and support!

~Don’t Stare Team

notes.title: Dev Update 2.0 - Summer Edition!
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the second Dev Update for Don't Stare, our indie platformer that follows the adventures of an introvert on a quest for peace and tranquility, while on the run from loud-mouthed but good natured extroverts!

It is the height of summer and we are sweating buckets! Not on account of the weather, but rather because of the hot updates that we have released into the game. 

Here is what we have been working on for the past scorching month! 

Room customization feature

One of the key traits of introverts is their creativity. One of the main conduits for this creativity in Don't Stare will be our room customization feature which will allow you to design, furnish and decorate your very own fortress of solitude, away from the hustle and the bustle of the outside world. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/fbc9fe40050c25ddeb4e80aba1ae828a02095cfe.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/30a68fef67f8c88c3c81a06c6f518f1be5a2862d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/9c3d1252159bb8574912262865dc1ee0bc69e340.jpg

Items  can be collected through gameplay and are separated by room set. Each item is interchangeable and you can mix and match to find the perfect tapestry of your seclusion. We are now up to 10 different room sets, some of which you may have  noticed if you follow us on social media! 

On the programming side, the collection and decoration features themselves are done, currently being tested. Good things come to those who wait, and we literally cannot wait to see our players unleash their inner interior designer! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/e8e838c5be6349eb164d2068f9795c8ed39efcb5.jpg

New extrovert characters

The roster of extrovert characters that want to talk your ear off is expanding and we are very excited that the Bois are finally in the game! This gym-bro trio might seem intimidating at a first glance, but when benching their friend, they can actually function as a platform, allowing the player to jump even higher and reach places normally out of their reach. 

There are four other extrovert characters that we are currently working on, which we may reveal in the near future. 

Follow us on social media to be among the first to find out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/a192d3c9a283cd6006ab6b2ba7f72141fd38972f.png

Parkour System

Our introverted main character is athletic as they come, using their high-powered legs to leap out of the way of incoming smalltalk. But did you know that not all jumping schemes are created equal. 
We are very happy to have reached the milestone of marking our parkour system as complete this past month. 

What is the parkour system? It is an optional movement mechanic that allows you to use parkour items in the world to maneuver faster! It allows you to run up walls, bounce off objects, and balance-run along railings and other such objects. 

No level requires Parkour to finish it, and Parkour routes are usually more dangerous than the normal route, but it'll let you move through the level faster.

Other additions and improvements:

 We have added several level hazards and objects, like gusts of wind that move your character, a hiding feature that lets you avoid extroverts, and more!
 We are currently working on implementing cut scenes and cinematics.
 Talking animations for the main character's friends are ready.

That is it for this dev update. Thank you for reading and do not forget to wishlist if you have not already!

notes.title: Dev Update 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello there!

If you are reading this then you’ve found your way to our Steam page and may have some interest in our little project, or maybe you wound up here by the sheer randomness of life. 

Either way, you are awesome and welcomed!  

Originally announced in 2020, Don’t Stare is currently in development and we hope to release it soon. With this first update, and more to follow, our aim is to chronicle our dev-adventures in the quest to bring this title to the masses.

Without further ado, here’s what we have been up to!

We had the opportunity to run a playtest or two in the last 2 years, and the feedback we collected was invaluable!  Following that process, we are currently working on a FTUE tutorial to help future users get started in the game and learn the ropes. 

Don’t Stare is not the most complicated game out there, but we know how important it is to make our game accessible to all players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/d52769a6ff089f3ace3a78ab658d6961b30e8777.jpg

On the art front, our team has been busy creating more assets than ever before. We have added new levels with themes such as a coffee shop, grocery store and subway.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/aa92b0468ce1fd869e9d633ca792b443cfe69f8d.jpg

We've also introduced new characters, including the Bois, Mom and Dad with the baby, and the Old Man. 

The main character's friends are now also in the game, and we can’t wait for you to meet them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/c436ca6d338fd16c736e84a0dcef9ea4fb05047d.jpg

Moving onto gameplay, we've polished and added new extrovert models, as well as fixed some bugs in the progressing story and checkpoints. 

We've also made some improvements in the main character's movements to make the parkour really jump off the screen. 

When it comes to UI and UX, we've implemented new menus and polished access to missions and chats, as well as fixed some UI navigation bugs. We've added more features such as character customization and an in-game music player, so you can explore all of the game's music.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/13c1f191fc44ace72fa6f50564051bea6e3e7bd5.jpg

Speaking of music, our Sound Designer and Music composer has produced more than an hour of original music for the game! We have music for specific parts of the story, as well as for special levels, different scenarios, and for the main character's personal development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224458/12d745535a0aac7acd70755fcf3729dd3d123f3d.jpg

We've also added sound-effects for almost everything in the game, including characters, UI, and gameplay feedback.

Make sure to follow our social media channels where we will be premiering some of the new tracks added soon!

If you're as excited as we are about the game, please share this dev update and don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam so you can be notified when the game will  be released. 

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait for you to step into the shoes and of our Introvert Main Character to and achieve anti-social greatness!
